message.content:
Yes—Atlanta’s city government has a formal way to handle noise complaints. Here’s how you can file one: | Step | What to Do | Where / How | |------|------------|-------------| | **1** | Gather details | • Exact address or intersection
• Date & time of the disturbance
• Description of the sound (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)
• Any evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings) | | **2** | File the complaint | • **Phone:** Call the City of Atlanta’s 311 service at **(404) 656‑4000** (24 hrs/day, 7 days/week).
• **Online:** Visit the official 311 portal at and select “Noise Complaint.” | | **3** | Follow up | After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Keep it handy for any follow‑up calls or emails. | ### Quick Reference * **City of Atlanta – 311 Service** * Phone: (404) 656‑4000 * Online: * **Noise Ordinance Information** * The city’s noise regulations are outlined in the Atlanta Municipal Code, Title 10, Chapter 5. You can read the full text here: (look under “Noise” sections). If you’re dealing with a recurring issue, you can also request a site visit from the City’s Environmental Health or Police Department, depending on the nature of the noise. Just let the dispatcher know you’d like a follow‑up inspection.
